lessons.title: Origins — Degrassi, Jewish/Black Identity & Toronto’s Multicultural Soup

body.text: Toronto’s Multicultural Soup Goals: Teach identity complexity. “How do all these cultures show up in his sound?”

body.label: Key points
items: Born in Toronto to a Black American father (musician) & Jewish Canadian mother
Mixed identity influences his perspective in rap
Used TV money to fund music
Toronto’s Caribbean/Afro-diasporic culture shaped his slang, flows, melody choices
Early collaborations with Trey Songz, Lil Wayne, Bun B
